name: stripe-mpp
description: Expert subagent and skills for implementing the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) — the open standard co-authored by Stripe and Tempo Labs for HTTP 402-based machine-to-machine payments, enabling AI agents to pay for API calls, data, and services autonomously.
